To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) the proposed TOM model outperforms the state-of-the-art opinion mining models; (ii) the hybrid classifier scheme outperforms the traditional classification models; (iii) the proposed TOM framework can be used to extract opinions from Twitter in a real-time manner.

the proposed TOM framework is capable of classifying tweets as positive, negative, or neutral, with an accuracy of 82.8% on average, and 85.3% on average for the tweets that contain at least one opinion word.

the proposed TOM framework is able to achieve an accuracy of 86.7% for the classification of tweets into positive and negative categories and an accuracy of 84.8% for the classification into positive and negative and neutral categories.
